definitions.explanation: A measure or principle used as a basis for judgment or comparison.

examples.japanese: {合格|ごうかく}の{規準|きじゅん}は{何|なん}ですか。
examples.english: What are the criteria for passing?

examples.japanese: この{規準|きじゅん}に{基|もと}づいて{判断|はんだん}する。
examples.english: I will judge based on this standard.

examples.japanese: {国際|こくさい}{規準|きじゅん}を{満|み}たす{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: It needs to meet international standards.

notes:
{規準|きじゅん} means a standard, criterion, or norm used as a basis for judgment or comparison.

KANJI NOTE:
Also very commonly written as {基準|きじゅん}. Both spellings are read きじゅん and are largely interchangeable. {基準|きじゅん} (with {基|き} = foundation) is more common in everyday use; {規準|きじゅん} (with {規|き} = rule) emphasizes an established rule or regulation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {規準|きじゅん}を{設|もう}ける: to establish a standard
- {規準|きじゅん}を{満|み}たす: to meet a standard
- {規準|きじゅん}に{基|もと}づく: to be based on a standard
- {判断|はんだん}の{規準|きじゅん}: criterion for judgment
- {国際|こくさい}{規準|きじゅん}: international standard

RELATED TERMS:
- {標準|ひょうじゅん}: standard (more general, as in "standard level")
- {水準|すいじゅん}: level, standard (often for quality or economic level)
